data.desc: Callan JMB Inc. (NASDAQ: CJMB) provides logistics, infrastructure, and operational services supporting the healthcare industry, emergency management agencies, government organizations, and other entities responsible for maintaining essential services. The Company's capabilities include product fulfillment, specialty packaging, warehousing, cold-chain logistics, monitoring, regulatory compliance, emergency preparedness, and response operations. Through continued expansion, Callan JMB is leveraging its expertise in critical infrastructure and supply chain management to address challenges of national importance.
